case_name: K.M. Nanavati v. State of Maharashtra
summary: Landmark case on grave and sudden provocation in murder.
ratio_decidendi: Grave and sudden provocation must be such as to deprive a reasonable man of self-control, leading to the act of killing.

case_name: Bachchan Singh v. State of Punjab
summary: Constitutionality of death penalty and sentencing guidelines.
ratio_decidendi: Death penalty should be awarded only in the rarest of rare cases when the alternative option is foreshadowed.

case_name: Lalita Kumari v. Govt of UP
summary: Mandatory registration of FIR for cognizable offences.
ratio_decidendi: Registration of FIR is mandatory under Section 154 CrPC if information discloses a cognizable offence.

case_name: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
ratio_decidendi: Section 377 IPC is unconstitutional to the extent it criminalizes consensual sexual acts between adults.

case_name: State of Delhi v. Sanjay Kumar
summary: High Court decision on circumstantial evidence in robbery case.
follows_sc_case: Lalita Kumari v. Govt of UP

summary: High Court decision on theft of property from a dwelling house.
